audio.note: The SMK25 sends MIDI control data. It has no documented internal sound engine or audio output.

ports.name: USB-B MIDI
ports.purpose: computer or mobile-host MIDI controller connection and charging

ports.name: pedal-port MIDI OUT
ports.connector: 1/4-inch rear pedal port after software reconfiguration
ports.constraint: replaces the pedal role of that port

messages: pad note, CC, or program-change assignments
encoder-assigned MIDI CC, aftertouch, or pitch information
arpeggiator, Smart Scale, and Smart Chord note output

surface: arpeggiator, Smart Scale, and Smart Chord controls

connection_rules.rule: The SMK25 cannot create audible sound by itself. Route its MIDI to a software instrument, FM-1, XPS-30, or other sound module, then route that sound source's audio separately.
USB-B MIDI requires a computer or mobile host. It is not a direct USB connection to the XPS-30 USB COMPUTER port.
To use the rear 1/4-inch port as wired MIDI OUT, reconfigure it in the vendor software and accept that it is no longer available for sustain. Record the adapter wiring and target before live use.

roles: compact USB or BLE MIDI keyboard for a host
direct hardware MIDI controller after the pedal-port role is changed
wireless MIDI controller with the optional M-VAVE adapter
unknowns: The manual does not establish a Linux editor or BLE support path.
The exact adapter wiring required by the reconfigured 1/4-inch MIDI OUT must be recorded from the supplied hardware or verified documentation.
